The '''Dancing Goddess''' was an essential component of the [[House of the Goddess]] techno-organic machine of [[Godo]] in the form of a green statuette. The machine was designed to protect the [[Godoan/Legends|Godoans]] from extinction, and a malfunction, such as the removal of any of its components, affected the entire [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="SW#99" /> The Dancing Goddess, along with another statuette from the House of the Goddess known as the [[Minstrel]], were much sought after, as it was said that they led the way to great power when brought together.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The Dancing Goddess was once retrieved by [[BoShek/Legends|BoShek]] in return for paid debts to [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].<ref name="Underworld" /> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] stole the statue on a visit to Godo and stored it in his [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Desilijic Complex/Legends|town house]]. After the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] death, [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]] robbed the town house and took the Goddess with him. He sold it back to an art dealer on [[Tharkos]], demanding an exorbitant price for it.<ref name="WWitMRB" /> At some point prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] won the Dancing Goddess and the Minstrel in a game of cards.<ref name="SW#99" /> He claimed to have the two artifacts in his possession since his days as [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], however,<ref name="SW#79">[[Star Wars (1977) 79|''Star Wars'' (1977) 79]]</ref> so it is possible that the one owned by Jabba was a fake.

The removal of the Dancing Goddess and the Minstrel were the cause of the [[Godoan's disease|affliction]] which ravaged Godo and its native species.<ref name="SW#99" />
